_what: What tools/release/export_public.py exports from the development repository to the public one (RELEASING.md). The public tree is the release commit's tree with the files under 'excluded' removed and nothing else changed. Every entry carries its reason; add one only with its reason.

required_public_files.reason: The PyPI trusted publisher registered for the public repository is bound to this file's name; a release without it cannot publish its tag.

guard._what: The release commit's own hygiene guard, run with the exported tree as its working directory and the export's index as its git index, with every leg it has. Exit status 0 is green; anything else refuses the export. names_file_option is how export_public.py --guard-names-file passes an untracked local names file, which only adds names.
